speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any rash, sensitivity to light, or changes in vision accompanying these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Since you had a fever and headache three days after eating ice cream, do you recall if the ice cream might have been from a specific source, like an ice cream social with unpasteurized milk? Also, have you developed a stiff neck or sensitivity to bright light since then?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeriosis in pregnancy)

The combination of fever, headache, anorexia, and fatigue occurring shortly after consuming ice cream is highly suggestive of Listeria monocytogenes infection, which is particularly dangerous during pregnancy. I will now request a blood culture and a lumbar puncture if necessary to confirm the diagnosis.
